title: Contact messages reach the owner even past the CRM allowance, the ticket tier editor opens the upgrade moment, and Get paid shows the fee a Space is charged

source.ref: Final stopping-point audit 2026-10-07 of #3275 to #3282 (owner ask: 'identify any bugs, missed connections or surfaces').

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCES: (1) submitContactForm returned success and stopped when captureLead returned null, which it does when the Space's contact allowance (space_crm meter, 250 on a free Space) refuses a new contact. The comment said the meter is not live; it goes live by itself when beta_grace ends on 2026-12-01, and since LIVE-832 the form is on every Space website, so owners would silently lose messages. (2) The contact form awaited the action with no catch, so a dropped request left the button stuck on Sending. (3) Get paid printed networkTakeRateBpsForPlan, which ignores the Founding Business buy-down that spaceNetworkBps applies at charge time: a Founding Business read 5% and was charged 3%. (4) The ticket tier editor showed the payments refusal ('Start its trial') as a red line with no button; LIVE-758 wired the event form, memberships, services and products but not this panel. (5) The membership checkout asked the payments gate without the space_memberships floor the tier write checks. (6) The refusal sentence typed '14-day' while the upgrade moment reads the trial length from pricing_settings.trial. (7) Three help articles implied selling without Business. THE FIX: the owner is emailed every message, with a line saying the CRM is at its limit when the contact was not added (the bell and deal still need the contact); the form catches a failed send; RateBand reads spaceNetworkBps(plan, spaceId); TicketTiersSection loads loadTicketTierUpgrade (lib/events/ticket-space-access.ts) and the panel mounts UpgradeMoment on a refusal; checkout passes also: 'space_memberships'; the refusal says 'free trial'; the help articles say Business. LEFT: the house website reads accentBeat.image, about.image and circles' ctaLabel/body, fields no block schema offers, so those always fall back (a Studio field change for its own row).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const act=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/contact-form-actions.ts');if(/if \\(!captured\\) return done/.test(act)||!/contactId: captured\\?\\.contactId \\?\\? null/.test(act)||!/contactId: string \\| null/.test(r('lib/crm/lead-notify.ts')))miss.push('a contact message the CRM allowance refuses never reaches the owner');if(!/try \\{\\s*const res = await submitContactForm/.test(r('components/spaces/contact-form-block.tsx')))miss.push('a failed contact send leaves the button stuck on Sending');if(!/spaceNetworkBps\\(space\\.plan, space\\.id/.test(r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/payments/payments-body.tsx')))miss.push('Get paid shows a Founding Business the unbought rate');const panel=r('app/(main)/events/[slug]/manage/ticket-tiers-panel.tsx');if(!/<UpgradeMoment/.test(panel)||!/isPaymentsRefusal\\(error\\)/.test(panel)||!/loadTicketTierUpgrade\\(/.test(r('app/(main)/events/[slug]/manage/sections.tsx')))miss.push('the ticket tier editor shows the payments refusal with no upgrade moment');if(!/spacePaymentsVerdict\\(space\\.id, \\{ plan: space\\.plan \\?\\? null, also: 'space_memberships' \\}\\)/.test(r('lib/billing/space-membership-checkout.ts')))miss.push('membership checkout skips the space_memberships floor the tier write checks');if(/\\d+-day trial/.test(r('lib/pricing/payments-copy.ts')))miss.push('the refusal copy types a trial length');if(!/Selling takes a Space on Business/.test(r('content/help/connecting/marketplace.md'))||!/once your Space is on Business/.test(r('content/help/spaces/teaching-across-studios.md'))||!/needs to be on Business/.test(r('content/help/groups/events.md')))miss.push('help still implies selling without Business');if(miss.length){console.error('SCAN-814: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
